name: re-engagement
title: Re-engagement call
outcome: Prospect is open to a short product demonstration

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hi Priya, we spoke earlier this year about coordinating field crews.

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: We now have 18 field staff across three locations.

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: Our concern is that a new tool could take too long to train everyone.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Would a short demonstration be useful before making a decision?

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: Yes, perhaps in two weeks after our seasonal handover.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'll send a few demonstration times by Thursday.
